allowed_actions.description: Choose one template or custom seed, optionally toggle up to eight cells, simulate and independently repeat at a translated origin.
allowed_actions.label: Test a life hypothesis

description: A research council tests living cell patterns, compares falsifiable claims with observed generations, and independently reproduces each run. Explore the saved frames or mutate a seed in your own local experiment.

facts: A 16 × 16 toroidal grid updates all cells simultaneously. Each cell has eight wrapping neighbors; a dead cell is born with three neighbors, and a living cell survives with two or three.
Each experiment declares a template or custom seed, optional cell toggles, a 4–48 generation observation window and a falsifiable hypothesis. Initial and computed generation frames are saved.
Periods and translations are measured from observed frames. An unobserved return remains inconclusive; a finite observation window never proves behavior for all future time.

A separate run starts from a translated seed and checks every observed generation for translation equivariance. Reproduction verifies this deterministic experiment, not an external biological finding.

Every tested seed enters a measured field guide; unknown behavior remains provisional. Submitted hypotheses are confirmed, rejected or unassessed separately. Retired guide entries and all experiments remain in the immutable decision history.

last_decision.reason: Explorer: test the glider template over 48 generations. Experimentalist: predict a period-four traveller with displacement (1,1), a falsifiable claim. Replication skeptic: prior observations confirmed that behavior for a glider, but this run’s frames and translated reproduction still require computation. Alternatives: repeat the block fixed point or custom offset blinker, both already measured.
